---
name: write-user-story
description: Use when asked to write user stories, requirements, or acceptance criteria for a feature.
---
1. Clarify the persona, goal, and value.
2. Write: "As a <persona>, I want <goal>, so that <value>."
3. Add Given/When/Then acceptance criteria, including error and edge cases.
4. List non-functional needs (performance, security, accessibility).
5. Save to `docs/requirements/<feature>.md`.
